title: gustar: check yourself
intro: 10 tasks: choose the form, fill the gaps, build sentences and translate.

items.prompt: A mis hermanos ___ gusta el fútbol.
items.explanation: Mis hermanos = ellos, so the pronoun is les.
optionNotes: Los is a direct object pronoun.
Gusta is for one thing or an action.
Gustas would mean “you are pleasing (to me)”.

items.explanation: A nosotros → nos. Viajar is an action (infinitive), so the verb is gusta.

items.text: No me gustan {{1}} lunes, pero me gusta {{2}} fin de semana.
items.explanation: Things you like or dislike in general take the definite article: los lunes, el fin de semana.

answers: A mi madre no le gusta el café.
No le gusta el café a mi madre.
items.explanation: A + person, then no, then the pronoun le, then the verb.
Los animales is plural, so the verb is gustan.
An action you like is an infinitive after gusta.

items.source: Do you like dogs? (to a friend)
items.explanation: Te for a friend, gustan for a plural noun, and the article los.

items.prompt: Who likes chocolate? Write the pronoun and the verb.
items.explanation: Only the pronoun changes: me, te, le, nos, os, les. The verb stays gusta because el chocolate is one thing.

items.prompt: Match each sentence with the best reply.
items.explanation: También agrees with a positive sentence, tampoco with a negative one. Encantan is plural (los gatos); gusta is singular (la habitación).
